We test our homeowner tools where it matters most to us: at home. A patch of lawn and bare ground became gravel paths, raised beds and drip irrigation, with every quantity of soil, mulch and gravel worked out first with the same free calculators on our [Homeowners page](../homeowners.qmd).

![Before and after: bare ground and lawn edges turned into gravel beds and a raised garden bed.](../images/yard-before-after.jpg){fig-alt="Two photos side by side of the same backyard with a blue shed: before, with bare ground and a rough bed by the fence; after, with neat gravel borders, a raised bed and a hose."}

![The legal boss and site inspector checks the new raised bed. The wet circles show where each drip emitter waters the soil.](../images/raised-bed-drip-card.jpg){fig-alt="A husky sniffing a raised garden bed of dark soil with drip irrigation emitters, each surrounded by a circle of wet soil."}
